existing_tips: Object pronoun: 'mij/me' = me – 'mij' is stressed, 'me' is unstressed.
Object pronoun: 'u' = you (formal) – used in polite situations.
Modal verbs push the main verb to the end as infinitive: 'ik moet werken'.
'Me' (unstressed) and 'mij' (stressed) both mean 'me': 'Geef me dat' vs 'Dat is voor mij'.
V2 rule: the finite verb is always the second element in main clauses.
